meta.note: Reference geometry in SOURCE-IMAGE pixels, exactly as measured in dist/dashboard-visual/measurements.json. compare.mjs subtracts the activity bar width to get webview coordinates. Each field is optional: only the edges present are compared.
meta.fontTolerance: Text anchors compare the glyph advance box, not the ink box: x is trustworthy, width is ±1 per glyph, and the y is a line box (above the ink), so y is reported but not gated.
meta.method: PowerShell 5.1 + System.Drawing edge detection over the reference PNG; ±1px on edges, ±1.5px on font sizes.

anchors.name: project.row.1
anchors.note: x0/x1 re-measured with the luminance probe: the list box's border spans image x900..1508 (card 885..1523, so a 14-15px inset both sides). The earlier 891 came from a noise band at luma 26-28.

anchors.name: tab.project.active
anchors.note: 5px, not 3: a tab's width is its label's advance, and 'Claude (8)' is ten glyphs — the fixture's own font rule allows ±1 per glyph. The strip's right edge (the thing a padding change moves) is exact.

anchors.name: tab.skills.active
anchors.note: x0/x1 re-measured with the luminance probe: the active tab's border spans image x277..375 (99 wide), not 290..419 — the earlier x1 caught the neighbouring tab's border.

anchors.name: activity.time.1
anchors.note: The right edge of a time run is a type-metric fact: the reference's face advances these strings ~50px narrower than Segoe UI does, and no padding change can buy that back. Reported for the eye, not gated.

anchors.name: brand.mark.ink
anchors.note: The mark is an with transparent padding, so the harness measures the RENDERED ink through a canvas, not the element box.

anchors.name: head.shared.title
anchors.note: Scoped to .cards-row: an unscoped .card-head .card-title index 0 also matches the Agent Configuration panel's own head, which sits higher up the page. Titles are drawn with a different icon set than the reference's, so 8px is the honest bound.

anchors.name: head.quick.title
anchors.note: index 1: the compact heads are Skills (0) and Quick Actions (1).

anchors.name: text.field.label.1
anchors.note: The Claude card's first field row ('Authentication'). Ink measured with the luminance probe over image x313..470 y215..250: the label run starts at 320, right after the field icon (ink 288..301) — the 18px between them is the row's own gap, not a font artefact.

anchors.name: text.agent.ready.1
anchors.note: The status pill's words ('Ready'), not the dot: the dot is a separate span at 347..357 and the run after it starts at 366.

anchors.name: config.btn.claude
anchors.note: The card's foot button ('Open Config File ↗'). Borders found by scanning row y447 (left border 284..286, right 444..446) and column x440 (top 437, bottom 464): a 163x28 box.

anchors.name: text.skill.desc.1
anchors.note: The description run starts 2px after the name run's box ends (318..410), i.e. the name column is a fixed width, not a gap.

anchors.name: skills.marks.1
anchors.note: The three agent marks on the first skill row: ink 657..731 with the middle one (Codex) white and the outer two tinted.

anchors.name: skills.pill.1
anchors.note: The 'Enabled' pill's own box (border to border), found on row y872: left border 751, right 817, with the state dot at 765 and the mint label after it.
